entries.text: Ganoes Paran — twelve years old; while his father discusses trade at Mock's Hold, he stands on the wall and tells the Bridgeburner commander he means to become a soldier.
entries.provenance: who's the kid on the wall at the very start?

entries.text: Sorry — a young fishergirl of Itko Kan who, after the old woman Rigga's prophecy and an encounter with two shadow-clad figures, takes the name Sorry and enlists in the Malazan Marines.
entries.provenance: who is Sorry and why does the book linger on her?

questions.text: Who are the two figures that loose the hounds on the road?
questions.answer: On the road they reveal themselves as Cotillion and Ammanas.

questions.text: Will Kellanved really return, as the commander implies?
